<thought>The mass spectrum shows a molecular ion at m/z 127.10. Assuming this is the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is about 126.09 Da. The IR spectrum displays a strong carbonyl band (~1700 cm⁻¹) and an O–H stretch (~3500 cm⁻¹), indicating a molecule that contains both a carbonyl group and a hydroxyl group (i.e., a hydroxy‑carbonyl compound).  

A formula that fits these observations is C₇H₁₀O₂ (exact monoisotopic mass = 126.068 Da; [M+H]⁺ = 127.075 Da, close to the observed 127.099 Da). This formula has three degrees of unsaturation, consistent with one carbonyl (1 DBE) and a ring or double bond (2 DBE).  

To obtain concrete candidate structures, I will request a list of isomers for the formula C7H10O₂.</thought>
